title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Strixhaven teaching assistant who leads a first-year sample-collection trip to the Harrier's Wood and is in her second year as a TA for the class.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A first-year Strixhaven student with sharpened canines who likes sneaking up on Abigale and can climb and swing through branches.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A short, blue-skinned goblin first-year student who casts a glowing light and touches the sleeping moon creature.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A tidy, precise gorgon first-year student with serpentine hair who can turn people to stone.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A reserved brown-feathered owlin first-year student who signs and whose words are broadcast telepathically by a Silverquill hearing aid.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor who teaches the class and assigns Dina her duties.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A vast six-limbed creature with a moon for a head, asleep in a chamber beneath the dolmen gate until Sanar touches it; its roar floods the meadow with darkness.

entities.name: Harrier's Wood
entities.description: A lush forest an hour's walk from Strixhaven campus where the flora is considered magically neutral.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios whose first-years are on the field trip.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The students' home plane, where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals to other planes near Strixhaven; the students fall through one that opens without warning.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A rival force with mage hunters that was driven back from Strixhaven.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: One of Strixhaven's five colleges, whose mages use snarlflowers for teas, tinctures and essence.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The strange plane the students land on, where a sunlit meadow lies beside a dolmen gate into darkness.

entities.name: Dolmen gate
entities.description: A free-standing gateway of three spiral-patterned, moss-covered stones that divides the bright meadow from a dark cave.

entities.name: Blue faerie
entities.description: An unnamed small blue insect-like faerie that lures the students through the Omenpath and is transformed by the darkness into a green, regal-looking version.

events.summary: Dina announces the class has reached the Harrier's Wood for sample collection.
events.quote: We have reached the Harrier's Wood.

events.summary: Tamira explains that underclassmen may only now visit remote sites because the Oriq have been driven back.
events.quote: Now that the Oriq are effectively gone, we can reopen more remote locations for scholarship.

events.summary: Dina shows the students a snarlflower and sets them to gather six to ten unblemished blossoms each.
events.quote: you are each expected to gather no fewer than six and no more than ten unblemished snarlflower blossoms

events.summary: Kirol sneaks up on Abigale and startles her, and the two banter about signing and swearing.
events.quote: jumping at the sight of the figure behind her, making a hoarse squawking sound at the same time.

events.summary: Sanar tumbles out of the brush having lost his flowers, and Tamira gives him some of hers.
events.quote: That's why I've been gathering extra: you can have a few of mine,

events.summary: Sanar spots a small blue insect-like faerie in the trees; it laughs and flies off, and he chases it, taking Tamira's basket.
events.quote: He leapt to his feet and ran after the fleeing creature—taking Tam's sample basket with him.

events.summary: All four students trip over a tree root and tumble into a hole ringed with snarlflowers, falling into prismatic light.
events.quote: all four students rolled and tumbled through the leafy debris on the ground, straight into a large hole in the middle of the otherwise unremarkable clearing.

events.summary: The faerie giggles and dives into the hole after the students.
events.quote: giggling wildly, then dove after the students, disappearing into whatever waited on the other side.

events.summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
events.quote: "Not on Arcavios," said Tam.

events.summary: Abigale stops Tamira from touching a stone and refuses to leave the others to fly up for help.
events.quote: I'm not leaving you here.

events.summary: The students discover a free-standing dolmen gate dividing the sunlit meadow from darkness and decide to go through to find help.
events.quote: They stepped through the dolmen gate, and the darkness swallowed them all.

events.summary: Sanar conjures a glowing yellow light to illuminate the cave, earning Tamira's approval.
events.quote: a steadily glowing yellow ball appeared in the air in front of him.

events.summary: Kirol studies cave paintings of incarnations of the sun and moon trading places.
events.quote: Incarnations of the sun and moon, trading places,

events.summary: The students find the sleeping moon-headed creature from the paintings at the center of a silver-lit chamber.
events.quote: And there, at the center of the circle, was the moon-headed creature from the cave paintings.

events.summary: Sanar, drawn by the creature's autumnal presence, crosses into the circle and touches its neck.
events.quote: He pressed his palm against the cool, smooth neck of the creature

events.summary: The creature wakes and roars, terrifying the students.
events.quote: Its eyes opened, lambent as two smaller moons, devoid of iris or pupil but patterned with the pits and craters of an actual moon.

events.summary: Kirol yanks Sanar away from the creature and they flee as it stomps and sends a wave of near-solid darkness through the tunnel.
events.quote: Kirol darted forward, grabbing Sanar by the elbow, and yanked the smaller student away from the beast.

events.summary: The darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.
events.quote: the sky overhead erupted in stars, the sun becoming a thin eclipse ring of fire in the distance while the moon sprang to sudden, total fullness.

events.summary: The blue faerie is transformed by the darkness into a green, gold-flecked, vaguely regal creature and flies off following the dark.
events.quote: Most striking of all, the blue bled out of its carapace, replaced by gleaming, gold-flecked green.

events.summary: The darkness pours out of the dolmen gate, followed by distant screams.
events.quote: All that remained was the dark flowing out of the dolmen gate, and the distant sound of screams.

relations.note: Dina is a TA who plans to ask Vess for a different assignment.
relations.quote: she was going to ask Professor Vess to assign her to something less general next year
Kirol, we've talked about this! You can't sneak up on me!

relations.note: She shares her flowers with him.
relations.quote: you can have a few of mine

relations.note: Kirol rescues Sanar from the creature.
relations.quote: yanked the smaller student away from the beast.

relations.note: The gate stands in the meadow where the students land.
relations.quote: There, behind where they had landed, was a massive gateway, formed of two tall stones with a third laid across them.

relations.note: Sanar wakes the creature by touching it, provoking its roar.
relations.quote: Naturally, that was when the creature woke up.
